premises.text: Mainstream social media exposes kids to predatory algorithms, addiction loops, strangers, data compromise, and inappropriate content
premises.evidence_span: predatory algorithms, addictive behavioral loops that reinforce toxic mindsets, strangers and creepers, not the Minecraft kind, sliding into DMs, compromised personal data, and inappropriate videos and messaging

premises.text: Kids need to be taught how to engage and disengage with technology as a learned skill
premises.evidence_span: They need to be taught how to engage and how to disengage with technology

premises.text: Incumbent platforms leave an unmet market for products made for kids
premises.evidence_span: The incumbents have left a soft spot in the market for products for kids

premises.text: Kid-friendly creator tools and co-creation support entertainment, self-expression, and developmental learning
premises.evidence_span: kid-friendly versions of the creator tools that we see on major platforms

premises.text: Guided profiles and socially appropriate communication teach digital literacy without open trolling
premises.evidence_span: we guide them to be socially and emotionally appropriate in their communication

premises.text: Parents can customize and stage tool access by age and preference via a guided curriculum
premises.evidence_span: parents can customize the platform for the age and stage of their child and for their personal preferences

premises.text: Expert-curated, developmentally moderated content keeps the feed age-appropriate
premises.evidence_span: curated and moderated by experts, by adults trained in developmental psychology and in our editorial guidelines

premises.text: Verified parental consent keeps the platform privacy-compliant worldwide
premises.evidence_span: all of this is done with verified parental consent, ensuring that we're privacy compliant around the world

premises.text: Starting with curated content jumpstarts engagement, network effects, and social-graph data before full social features
premises.evidence_span: intentionally starting with content for our beta, because this addresses a major pain point for parents, age-appropriate content

premises.text: Growth comes from parent networking and brand partnerships, then kid invitation systems
premises.evidence_span: doing good old-fashioned networking with parents and leveraging brand partnerships
